description: This file contains shell script code for testing signal handling behavior in a git-related environment. It defines test descriptions, uses a test library, runs several test cases verifying signal propagation, including assertions for handling signals like SIGTERM and SIGPIPE, and contains utility functions for creating git blobs.

methods.name: large_git
methods.description: Function that runs 'git diff --cached --binary' 100 times, designed to test git's behavior under stress.
